game_concept: A strategy race set in Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall, a frozen waterfall: the rescue climber must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall: a frozen waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Waterfall, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the rescue climber ahead. Then check the vowels value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the radio mast by solving code steps involving vowels that move the rescue climber forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the radio mast first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Vowel Counter' (Week 8 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Frozen Waterfall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

code_snippet:
for ch in word:
    if ch in 'aeiou':
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Frozen Waterfall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
